identifiability.occupancy_equation: Under a steady-flow approximation O = J * tau, normalized footprint F = O/Z, so J_t/J_c = (F_t/F_c)*(Z_t/Z_c)*(tau_c/tau_t). This is a model identity, not fitted or measured rates.
identifiability.implication: A relative-footprint increase can coexist with absolute-synthesis decrease. Matched RNA permits relative occupancy-per-RNA analysis but still does not determine completion flux if calibration or residence time changes.
identifiability.not_asserted: No particular RNA, initiation, elongation or normalization mechanism is identified as the cause of the GSE118660 reversal. No human or Schwann transfer.

next_discriminating_test.context: Within each MEF and NIH3T3 model separately, repeat control and 2h Tg at both 200nM and 1uM; explicitly independent culture preparations, dose-by-cell factorial design. Transfer to Schwann cells is a separate experiment.
measurements: Split same cultures/time for per-cell calibrated total RNA and RPF
Record external standards, cell numbers, assay recovery and viability
PMP22 nascent completed protein via validated short pulse and targeted recovery, not total protein alone
Positional footprints and runoff/transit control for elongation/stalling
RNA pulse/chase or nascent transcription if assigning abundance change to decay
Primary predeclared background/control panel and full feature universe; preserve missing versus zero
next_discriminating_test.conditional_prediction: Selective loading predicts a reproducible PMP22 condition-by-assay effect after verified global calibration and matched RNA, with a concordant nascent PMP22 rate change. RNA-only explanation predicts the calibrated RPF change is accounted for by RNA within a predeclared equivalence margin. Opposite relative but not absolute effects implicate normalization, not opposite synthesis. Occupancy increase without completed-protein increase and with longer residence supports elongation/stalling.
next_discriminating_test.decision_rule: Do not interpret nonsignificance as equivalence. Predeclare a scientifically justified equivalence margin and replication/power using real pilot variance before collecting independent data; these exploratory results cannot set a confirmatory success threshold post hoc.
